sides.text: Strong, static types with inference; / is fractional division
sides.code:
print (3 + 4 :: Int)
print (2 ^ 10, 7 `div` 2, 7 `mod` 2, 7 / 2)

let double :: Int -> Int
    double x = x * 2
print (double 21)

sides.text: Every function takes one argument; add 1 is a partial application
sides.code:
let add x y = x + y
    inc = add 1
print (inc 5, add 2 3)

let xs = [1, 2, 3]
print (0 : xs, xs ++ [4], head xs, tail xs, length xs, xs !! 1)

print [x * x | x <- [1 .. 10], even x]
print (take 5 [1, 3 ..])

let t = (1, "a", True)
print (fst (1, 2), snd (1, 2), t)

putStrLn (reverse "hello")
print (words "a b  c", unwords ["x", "y"])

let sign x | x < 0 = "neg"
         | x == 0 = "zero"
         | otherwise = "pos"
putStrLn (sign (-3))
putStrLn (case 5 of { 1 -> "one"; _ -> "many" })

sides.text: Define functions by cases on structure
sides.code:
let f [] = 0
    f (x : xs) = x + f xs
print (f [1, 2, 3])

sides.text: where binds names across guards of one definition
sides.code:
let area r = pi * sq where sq = r * r
print (area 2.0 :: Double)

let fact :: Integer -> Integer
    fact 0 = 1
    fact n = n * fact (n - 1)
print (fact 20)

print (map (* 2) [1, 2, 3])
print (filter odd [1 .. 6])
print (foldr (+) 0 [1 .. 10], foldl (flip (:)) [] [1, 2, 3])

print (map (\x -> x + 1) [1, 2])
print (map (subtract 1) [5], map (2 ^) [1, 2, 3])

sides.text: (f . g) x = f (g x); $ avoids parentheses

sides.code:
print (zip [1, 2, 3] "ab")
print (zipWith (+) [1, 2] [10, 20])

sides.text: Sum types: choices; product types: fields
sides.code:
data Shape = Circle Double
           | Rect Double Double
           deriving Show
area (Circle r) = 3 * r * r
area (Rect w h) = w * h

sides.text: Explicit absence and errors, no null
sides.code:
print (lookup 2 [(1, "a"), (2, "b")])
print (Right 5 :: Either String Int, Left "err" :: Either String Int)

class Describe a where describe :: a -> String
instance Describe Bool where describe b = if b then "yes" else "no"
putStrLn (describe True)

sides.text: Eq, Ord, Show, Read, Enum, Bounded, Num
sides.code:
print (compare 1 2, show 3, read "4" + 1, minBound :: Int)
print ([LT ..], succ 'a')

sides.text: Type variables are lowercase; constraints use =>
sides.code:
let twice :: (a -> a) -> a -> a
    twice f = f . f
print (twice (+ 3) 10, twice ('x' :) "")

let xs = [1 ..]
print (take 3 (map (* 2) xs))
let fibs = 0 : 1 : zipWith (+) fibs (tail fibs)
print (take 10 fibs)

sides.text: Map over a structure: fmap :: (a -> b) -> f a -> f b
sides.code:
print (fmap (+ 1) [1, 2, 3])
print (fmap (+ 1) (Just 1), (+ 1) <$> Nothing)

print ((+) <$> Just 1 <*> Just 2)
print (pure 5 :: [Int], (,) <$> [1, 2] <*> "ab")

let f x = if x > 0 then Just (x * 2) else Nothing
print (Just 3 >>= f >>= f)
print (do { a <- Just 1; b <- Just 2; return (a + b) })
print (do { x <- [1, 2]; y <- "ab"; return (x, y) })

sides.text: Side effects live in IO; pure functions cannot perform them
sides.code:
main :: IO ()
main = do
  putStrLn "name?"
  let name = "Ada"
  putStrLn ("hi " ++ name)

print ([1] <> [2], mconcat ["a", "b"], mempty :: String)
print (foldMap (\x -> [x, x]) [1, 2])
print (sum (Just 3), length (1, 2), traverse (\x -> if x > 0 then Just x else Nothing) [1, 2, 3])

sides.text: Thread state or effects through pure code; mtl and transformers provide them
sides.code:

-- StateT adds state to any monad
print ((\s -> (s * 2, s + 1)) 5)

sides.code:

print (Age 3)

sides.text: Same input, same output: refactor by substitution
sides.code:
let f x = x + 1
print (f 2 == f 2, map f [1, 2] == [f 1, f 2])

let go acc [] = acc
    go acc (x : xs) = go (acc + x) xs
print (go 0 [1 .. 10])
